title: 第23章 赶来凡王府的萧玉虎第24章 萧凡疯狂的飙演技
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
不仅对于武道实力有着极高的标准与要求，
就连个人的资历以及其身后所依仗的背景等等方面的审查，
也是严苛到了极点。
从外表上来看，京兆府的府尹叶大富脸上堆满了笑容，活脱脱像个弥勒佛一般，显得颇为滑稽可笑。
只见他极其客气地说道：“慕容大人您可真是会开玩笑！咱们这京兆府呢？不过就是负责维持一下都城的社会治安而已啦！
平日里也就是处理些诸如纠纷、小偷小摸之类的琐碎杂事罢了。
至于像给皇子下毒这般重大的案件，
还得仰仗慕容大人您所在的神捕司出手办理并成功侦破才行呐！”
说到这里，他稍稍停顿了一下，
接着又补充道：“要不然，圣上也不至于特意降下旨意，明确让神捕司来主办此案，而我们京兆府仅仅只是从旁协助了。”
听到这番话后，慕容清雅不由得冷哼了一声，没好气儿地道：
“哼，你这个叶死胖子心里清楚就好！少在这里跟本大人啰嗦！”
言毕，
她便不再理会那京兆府的府尹叶大富，转身自顾自地忙活去了。
只见她猛地转过身来，目光如炬地看向神捕司那一群身着青衣与紫衣的捕快们，
以一种不容置疑的口吻大声下令道：
“将与这起案件有关的所有天香楼人员统统分开看押起来！不得有误！
各位紫衣捕快听令，你们各自率领一队人马，立刻前往各家朝廷官员的家族之中，
务必把那些与本案相关的人员一个不漏地请过来接受调查。
若遇到哪家胆敢不予以配合，你们无需多言，直接当场宣读陛下的口谕即可！

都明白了吗？”
听到命令后，
每一队的紫衣捕快不敢有丝毫怠慢，纷纷赶忙向这位威风凛凛的姑奶奶恭敬地拱了拱手，
齐声应道：“属下遵命！”
紧接着，一批又一批来自神捕司的人马便按照既定的部署，
有条不紊且迅速有序地开始行动了起来。
此时，站在天香楼大堂中央的京兆府府尹叶大富目睹着神捕司如此雷厉风行的举动，
心中不禁暗暗叫苦不迭。
他暗自咒骂道：
“哎，瞧这阵势，想必当今陛下和萧氏皇族这次是真的被激怒了！
若是此番调查当真能查出哪怕是一星半点的蛛丝马迹，恐怕有些家伙就要大祸临头咯！
老天爷保佑，可千万别让这件事情牵连到我们叶家头上才好……”
想到此处，叶大富的额头上不由自主地冒出了一层细密的汗珠。
因为只有他们这些拥有那传说中的神话级别老祖坐镇的各大霸主势力，
才有可能接触到关于萧氏皇族的些许秘密，
并从中窥探到这个古老家族所隐藏的恐怖底蕴与可怕之处。
即便是他们这些势力，所了解到的信息或许也仅仅只是萧氏皇族神秘面纱下的冰山一角而已。
且说另一边，
萧氏皇族的大宗正萧玉虎在离开了戒备森严、气势恢宏的皇宫之后，
便毫不犹豫地翻身上马，快马加鞭地朝着自己那位备受瞩目的六侄子萧凡的凡王府疾驰而去。

他心急如焚，仿佛有什么十万火急之事亟待解决。
content_en:
Not only does it have extremely high standards and requirements for martial arts strength,
Even the review of personal qualifications and the background behind them, etc.,
It is also extremely harsh.
Judging from the appearance, Ye Dafu, the governor of Jingzhao Mansion, has a smile on his face and looks like a Maitreya Buddha, which is quite funny.
I saw him saying extremely politely: "Mr. Murong, you are really good at joking! What about our Jingzhao Mansion? We are just responsible for maintaining public order in the capital!"
On weekdays, I just deal with trivial matters such as disputes and petty theft.
As for a serious case like poisoning the prince,
We have to rely on Mr. Murong, your Divine Catcher Division, to handle the matter and successfully detect it! "
At this point, he paused for a moment.
Then he added: "Otherwise, the Holy Spirit wouldn't have issued a decree specifically asking the Divine Catcher Division to take charge of this case, and our Jingzhao Mansion just assisted from the side."
After hearing these words, Murong Qingya couldn't help but snorted coldly and said angrily:
"Hmph, you fat man, you just need to know better! Stop nagging me here!"
After finishing speaking,
She ignored Ye Dafu, the governor of Jingzhao Mansion, and turned around to mind her own business.
She turned around suddenly and looked at the group of detectives in green and purple clothes from the Divine Catcher Division with burning eyes.
He ordered loudly in an unquestionable tone:
"All Tianxianglou personnel related to this case will be detained separately! There must be no mistakes!
All Purple-clothed Policemen, please obey the order. Each of you will lead a team of troops and immediately go to the families of the various imperial officials.
Be sure to invite all those involved in this case to come for investigation.
If you encounter anyone who dares not to cooperate, you don’t need to say anything, just read out His Majesty’s oral instructions on the spot!
Do you understand? "
After hearing the order,
The purple-clad detectives in each team did not dare to show any signs of neglect and hurriedly bowed their hands respectfully to this majestic aunt.
They responded in unison: "I obey my orders!"
Immediately afterwards, batch after batch of men and horses from the Divine Catching Division followed the established deployment,
Started to act methodically and quickly.
At this time, Ye Dafu, the governor of Jingzhao Mansion, who was standing in the center of the Tianxiang Tower lobby, witnessed such a resolute move by the Chief Inspector,
I couldn't help but secretly complain in my heart.
He cursed secretly:
"Hey, look at this formation, His Majesty and the Xiao royal family must have been really angered this time!
If this investigation can really find even a little bit of clues, I'm afraid some guys will be in trouble!
God bless us, but we must not let this matter involve our Ye family..."
Thinking of this, a layer of fine beads of sweat appeared on Ye Dafu's forehead involuntarily.
Because they are the only major overlord forces that have the legendary mythical level ancestors,
Only then would it be possible to come into contact with some secrets about the Xiao royal family.
And from it, we can get a glimpse of the terrifying details and terrible things hidden by this ancient family.
Even those forces like them may only know the tip of the iceberg under the mysterious veil of the Xiao royal family.
Let’s talk about the other side,
After leaving the heavily guarded and majestic palace, Xiao Yuhu, the eldest son of the Xiao royal family,
He got on his horse without hesitation and galloped towards the palace of his much-anticipated sixth nephew, Xiao Fan.
He was extremely anxious, as if there were some urgent matters that needed to be resolved.
